$Comment: Put up Christmas decorations during one Christmas. PLACE_BLOCK counts each one placed, and the PREFIX match takes the game's own winter pieces (WinterHoliday_: the garland, lights, stocking, snowman, snowflake, bauble and the rest), its wreath (Winter_Holiday_Wreath, spelt apart) and its Christmas Packets (Furniture_Christmas_Chest_Small_, every colour). Nothing can be placed in the Forgotten Temple, so it is done at home. The description's number comes from the criterion's Amount through @amount. The merry tag counts it toward the Merrymaker. Each year's copy pays a few Christmas Coins and MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row once, Building XP for the decorating, both waiting on the achievements page until the player collects them. The Mmo_Xp row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the coins still pay. The _Christmas folder makes the id christmas_decorator.
